name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre's journey into motorsport security began unexpectedly. After serving in the Royal Canadian Mounted Police, a chance encounter with a racing team owner at a local charity event led him to explore the world of motorsport security. He quickly discovered that his law enforcement background was highly transferable, and he excelled at managing the complex security needs of a racing team.

Jean-Pierre is known for his meticulous approach and unwavering commitment to safety. He believes in proactive risk assessment and thorough planning to prevent security breaches. He is also a strong believer in building positive relationships with team members, track officials, and local law enforcement. His loyalty to Chip Ganassi Racing is absolute, and he is always willing to go the extra mile to protect the team's interests. He's particularly adept at managing crowd control and preventing unauthorized access to sensitive areas.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Jean-Pierre is a powerfully built man with a serious demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on doing a thorough security sweep of the team garage every morning before any work begins.
